executive_summary.headline: The strongest builder signal is governance expressed as code.

top_picks.title: Agentic workflows add policy and review to CI
top_picks.author: GitHub
top_picks.summary: A workflow toolkit shows how agent steps can be expressed as reviewable automation with explicit permissions and repository-level controls.
key_takeaways: Treat tool access as an API surface with explicit identity.
Measure failure and recovery, not only task completion.
top_picks.results: Non-production implementation pattern: pinned repository, scoped credentials, traces, and human approval for write actions.
top_picks.enterprise_adaptation: Use the implementation pattern in a sandbox with least-privilege service identities and version-pinned dependencies. In a regulated environment, require data residency review, model governance approval, secrets isolation, immutable audit logs, and a documented rollback. Within 30 days, pilot one read-only workflow against synthetic or masked data and measure completion, exceptions, latency, and operator review time.
